Baseline Requirements

What We
Look For.

We maintain a rigorous filtering process to ensure capital is directed toward sustainable, financially robust infrastructure projects that have a demonstrable impact on the real economy.

Commercial & Industrial (C&I) Focus

Projects must primarily serve commercial and industrial off-takers with demonstrable energy needs and capacity to pay.

Technology Readiness

Utilization of commercially proven technologies (e.g., Solar PV, Battery Storage, Mini-grids) with standard warranties.

Financial Viability

Strong project economics featuring long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or sustainable revenue models yielding stable cash flows.

Environmental & Social Impact

Clear articulation of greenhouse gas reduction potential and socio-economic benefits aligned with our ESG framework.

Regulatory Compliance

Adherence to all national and sub-national regulatory requirements, environmental permits, and licensing.

Sponsor Track Record

Developer/Sponsor must demonstrate technical expertise, operational capability, and prior experience delivering similar scale projects.

Investment Process

From Pitch to Deployment

Our structured investment process ensures transparency, speed, and thorough evaluation for prospective developers.

01

Initial Screening

Submission of project teaser and high-level financials to assess alignment with fund mandate.

02

Concept Review

Detailed review of technical feasibility, sponsor track record, and preliminary ESG impact.

03

Due Diligence

Comprehensive legal, technical, financial, and environmental due diligence before term sheet issuance.

04

Investment Committee

Final presentation to the IC for approval and capital deployment scheduling.
